articles.summary: Late-breaking data from Phase 3 investigational study presented at the American College of Rheumatology Convergence show 58% of ICOTYDE-treated patients achieved an ACR20 response and 29% achieved an ACR50 response at Week 16 ICOTYDE is a first-in-class IL-23R targeted oral peptide, demonstrating significant joint and skin improvements and a favorable safety profile in a once-daily pill Johnson Johnson (NYSE: JNJ) today announced positive results from a Phase 3 study investigating ICOTYDE ® (icotrokinra) in biologic-naïve adults with active psoriatic arthritis (PsA). a,b ICOTYDE is the first and only targeted oral peptide that precisely blocks the IL-23 receptor. 1 ICOTYDE met the primary endpoint, with 58% of patients achieving an American College of Rheumatology 20 (ACR20) response compared with 41% receiving placebo at Week 16. 2 Safety findings were consistent with the established safety profile of ICOTYDE, with no new safety signals identified.
